reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). CustoJusto publishes Partners API v2 (official GitHub custojusto/partnersapi) for PRO advertisers to export/manage ads via API; no public search API.

reason: Upload-only official API (https://docs.v2.custojusto.pt/): CustoJusto publishes Partners API v2 (official GitHub custojusto/partnersapi) for PRO advertisers to export/manage ads via API; no public search API. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
